items.item_text: 01. All applicants are required to submit responses to the following supplemental questions. Your responses will provide information about your background and experience related to this position and will be used in the screening and selection process. Be concise yet specific and informative in your responses to these supplemental questions. "See resume," attachments or links will not be accepted as a substitute for your responses to the questions in the following boxes. Incomplete responses will not be considered. Please indicate below that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes | No

02. I understand that my application will be considered incomplete if any required sections of the application are not completed and/or if any documents that are required are not attached to my online application by the closing date. Options: Yes | No
03. Please specify your highest level of education. Options: High School or equivalent (GED) | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Juris Doctor | Doctorate Degree
04. Please indicate the field in which you have earned your degree in:

05. Indicate the full-time equivalent years of formal training or leadership experience related to the administrator's administrative assignment. Options: Less than one year | One year | Two years | Three years | Four years | Five years or more

06. Indicate where you obtained one (1) year of formal training or leadership experience related to the administrator's administrative assignment. 1. What was the time frame? 2. What was the employer's name? 3. Describe the work you performed. (This section is required)

07. Do you have experience administering noncredit and/or CE programs at a California community college? Options: Advanced experience independently administering both noncredit and Career Education (CE) programs at a California Community College. | Strong experience administering noncredit and/or Career Education (CE) programs at a California Community College. | Moderate experience supporting or coordinating noncredit and/or Career Education (CE) programs. | Basic experience with noncredit and/or Career Education (CE) programs through instructional, faculty, or staff responsibilities. | No relevant experience.

08. If you indicated that you have experience above, please describe your experience administering noncredit and/or Career Education (CE) programs. 1. What was the time frame? 2. What was the employer's name? 3. Describe the work you performed.

09. Do you have experience working with industry partners and workforce agencies? Options: Advanced experience developing, leading, and sustaining partnerships with industry partners, workforce agencies, employers, and community organizations. | Strong experience collaborating with industry partners, workforce agencies, employers, and community organizations to support programs or initiatives. | Moderate experience working with industry partners and/or workforce agencies on projects or program activities. | Basic experience interacting with industry partners and/or workforce agencies. | No relevant experience.

10. If you indicated that you have experience above, please describe your experience working with industry partners and workforce agencies. 1. What was the time frame? 2. What was the employer's name? 3. Describe the work you performed.

11. Indicate the level of knowledge of K-12 A-G program and curriculum implementation. Options: Advanced knowledge – Extensive knowledge of K-12 A-G requirements and curriculum implementation, including leading or overseeing program development, implementation, or alignment. | Strong knowledge – Working knowledge of K-12 A-G requirements and curriculum implementation through direct responsibility for planning, implementation, or coordination. | Moderate knowledge – General knowledge of K-12 A-G requirements and curriculum implementation with some experience supporting related activities. | Basic knowledge – Limited knowledge or exposure to K-12 A-G requirements and curriculum implementation. | No relevant knowledge or experience.
12. Please describe your knowledge of K-12 A-G program and curriculum implementation. Include your relevant experience if applicable and examples that demonstrate your knowledge.

13. Indicate the level of knowledge of California Community Colleges noncredit instruction and funding. Options: Advanced knowledge – Extensive knowledge of California Community College noncredit instruction and funding, including leadership or administrative responsibility for noncredit programs, funding, planning, and compliance. | Strong knowledge – Working knowledge of California Community College noncredit instruction and funding through direct responsibility for program administration, coordination, or implementation. | Moderate knowledge – General knowledge of California Community College noncredit instruction and funding with experience supporting related programs or initiatives. | Basic knowledge – Limited knowledge or exposure to California Community College noncredit instruction and funding. | No relevant knowledge or experience.
14. Please describe your knowledge California Community Colleges noncredit instruction and funding. Include your relevant experience if applicable and examples that demonstrate your knowledge.

15. Describe how you have demonstrated sensitivity and understanding in delivery of services and support to a diverse workforce and student population (diverse in terms of socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic background). This section is required.
16. Please indicate a demonstrated ability to articulate a meaningful commitment to the college's identity and mission.
Master's degree from an accredited institution.
Doctoral degree from an accredited institution.
One (1) year of formal training or leadership experience related to the administrator’s administrative assignment.

Demonstrated experience working with communities who have been traditionally underserved by higher education and experience in the pedagogy reflecting intersections of race, culture, class, ethnic, and queer communities.
Experience administering noncredit and/or CE programs at a California community college.
Experience working with industry partners and workforce agencies.

Assists the Dean in the administration and coordination of noncredit CE instructional programs, including short-term vocational training, workforce development, work experience, and industry-recognized credential programs.

Provides leadership in the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of noncredit CE curriculum in compliance with Title 5 regulations, California Community Colleges Chancellor's Office guidelines, and Pasadena City College policies and procedures.
Develops and maintains partnerships with employers, workforce boards, industry representatives, community organizations, and public agencies to support workforce alignment and job placement.
Assists or leads the development and implementation of A-G high school credit recovery programs and K-12 programming.
Supervises and evaluates assigned faculty, classified professionals, and support staff in accordance with PCC policies and applicable collective bargaining agreements.
Assists in the development and monitoring of budgets, grants, contracts, and special funding related to noncredit CE and workforce programs.
Prepares reports, program reviews, data analysis, and documentation required for internal planning, accreditation, and external agencies.
Supports scheduling, enrollment management, and instructional delivery to maximize access, efficiency, and student success.
Collaborates with faculty to support curriculum development, student learning outcomes assessment, and instructional quality.
Supports the development and coordination of work-based learning opportunities, including noncredit work experience and internships.

Collaborates with credit and noncredit counseling, admissions and records, student services, and workforce offices to support onboarding, retention, and transition pathways from noncredit to credit and employment.
Leads and implements activities related to noncredit CE state initiatives.
Participates in shared governance, college committees, regional consortia, and workforce initiatives as assigned.

Directly manages all aspects of the employee lifecycle, including recruitment, transfers, suspensions, layoffs, recalls, promotions, terminations, task assignments, performance evaluations, rewards, disciplinary actions, and grievance resolution, ensuring adherence to District policies and legal requirements.
Performs related duties as assigned.
Knowledge of California Community Colleges noncredit instruction and funding.
Ability to analyze data and prepare clear written and oral reports.
Knowledge of Title 5 regulations and CCCCO policies related to noncredit and CE.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex educational environment.
Knowledge of workforce development systems and labor market alignment.
Ability to provide effective administrative leadership and support.
Knowledge of curriculum development, program review, and student learning outcomes.
Ability to work collaboratively with faculty, staff, administrators, and external partners.
Knowledge of equity-minded and student-centered practices in adult education.
Knowledge of Title 5 workforce development funding.
Knowledge of state initiatives to expand healthcare pathways.
Knowledge of K-12 A-G program and curriculum implementation.
